name: Javier Milei
role: President of Argentina (2023-present); economist; national deputy (2021-2023)
summary: Milei is a libertarian economist who calls himself an anarcho-capitalist in theory while governing as a minarchist: he wants a drastically smaller state limited to defending life, liberty and property, deregulation, privatisation, zero deficit, free trade and fiscal austerity. Culturally he is socially conservative on abortion, euthanasia and gender, fights what he calls the woke agenda, and rejects supranational bodies such as the UN agenda, while aligning Argentina with the United States and Israel.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Told Davos in 2025 that positive rights (education, housing and similar) are an artificial expansion of the state that someone must pay for, and says the state should limit itself to life, liberty and property; he backs privatisation in health care.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Said in Davos 2024 and 2025 that market failures do not exist: if one is found, look for state intervention in the middle.

public-ownership.rationale: DNU 70/2023 and the Ley Bases bill proposed turning state firms into companies for privatisation and listed Aerolineas, AySA, ARSAT, Correo and rail among them.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Calls taxes coercive and says a heavier tax burden means less liberty; said the adjustment should fall on the state and that the private sector cannot keep being choked with taxes.

unions-good.rationale: Lists unions among the groups living off taxpayers (Davos 2025); his labour reform curbed union financing and strike rights, and he is described as opposing unions.

property-fundamental.rationale: Names life, liberty and private property as the three principles of his model and in 2026 called private appropriation of the fruits of one's creation a principle of natural law.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Argued in Davos 2024 that regulating monopolies and concentrated structures destroys growth and that regulation to fix supposed failures opens the door to socialism.

cut-welfare.rationale: Says the state should stop handing out "fish" to vulnerable people and teach them to fish, backs "he who blocks the street does not collect", but exempts people who receive subsistence aid because they have nothing to eat.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Has said he supports legalising drugs on libertarian grounds (own statements before office, reported in press); no later reversal found in the sources used.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Attacks censorship and labelling of dissent in Davos 2025, criticising the UK and EU for jailing or silencing speakers; his government dissolved the anti-discrimination institute INADI.

state-harmful.rationale: His clearest recent position is that the state should be reduced drastically and limited to defending life, liberty and property, not abolished; earlier anarcho-capitalist rhetoric was not his position for government.

limit-guns.rationale: Has backed free carrying of arms with no state limits, and in December 2024 his government lowered the minimum age for a gun licence from 21 to 18.

empower-police-military.rationale: Campaigned on "he who does it pays", said the state turned its back on those who protect citizens, and kept security spending out of the main cuts.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Said he sees nothing wrong with paying for sex since it is a free transaction; described as supporting legal prostitution.

rehabilitation.rationale: His security line is "el que las hace, las paga" and "adult crime, adult penalty" in the juvenile penal bill.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Said before taking office that adults should be free to marry whoever they want with no state intervention, though in 2025 his Davos speech attacked the "LGBT agenda" and his circle said the state should not promote homosexuality.

abortion-legal.rationale: Said in 2026 that life begins at conception and any interruption is murder; he has called for a plebiscite on abortion and his government weighed repeal.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Told Davos in 2025 that equality before the law is enough and rejects the idea of hidden injustices to be rectified; attacks quotas and diversity doctrine.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Called gender ideology a nefarious attack on the very idea of sex and rejected self-perceived identity (Davos 2025).

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Asks what is left for the future if young people are taught shame for their past, and says the West should return to the values that made it great.

gradual-change.rationale: Told Argentines there is no alternative to shock adjustment and urged leaders to be bold and abandon the script of recent decades.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Signed a May 2025 decree tightening immigration and citizenship rules and, at Davos 2025, called mass migration driven by guilt a reverse colonisation.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: At the UN in 2024 and 2025 he called the organisation a Leviathan of supranational bureaucrats and proposed that it intervene only where problems demonstrably exceed national capacity.

free-trade.rationale: Said in 2024 that where trade enters bullets do not (Bastiat) and, as president, concluded the EU-Mercosur deal and cut protections.

open-borders.rationale: Says free movement of goods and people is foundational to liberalism but opposes mass migration; his government restricted citizenship (most recent position used).

limit-growth.rationale: Said in Davos 2025 that economic development is treated as a near crime against nature by radical environmentalism and that this is wrong.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Called climate-change policy a woke distortion, said the Earth has had five cycles of sharp temperature change, and announced Argentina would study leaving the Paris Accord.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Announced the Argentine Nuclear Plan in December 2024, saying nuclear energy would have a triumphant return.

central-planning.rationale: Said collectivist experiments are the cause of citizens' problems and that planning distorts prices and prevents economic calculation.

socialized-markets.rationale: Holds that only free-enterprise capitalism is just and efficient; public ownership of firms is what he is privatising.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: DNU 70/2023 repealed the Compre Nacional and industrial promotion laws, and ended the import authorisation system (SIRA), opening the economy.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Argues that state interventions only distort the price system and that the state should be limited to protecting life, liberty and property.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Defends free-enterprise capitalism, in which wage labour is central, as the only moral system.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Before office he proposed closing the central bank under a Simons banking system with currency competition; as president his government kept and uses the central bank.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: Rejects state-run price and wage coordination and lists price controls among the tools of the "statist" model he opposes.

one-party-rule.rationale: Denounces the "party of the state" and the political caste, and presents his project as individual liberty.

political-violence-never.rationale: At the UN in 2025 condemned global political violence from the left as inadmissible, saying it is inadmissible to use force where reasons fail.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Now says the state must keep the defence of life, liberty and property, which includes defence and justice; his earlier anarcho-capitalism is not his governing position.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Says socialists replaced class struggle with other conflicts, and credits savings, investment and work for history's progress.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Rejects "social justice" as intrinsically unjust and says only equality before the law matters (Davos 2024 and 2025).

self-interest-moral.rationale: Said in Davos 2024 that the successful capitalist, serving others for his own gain, is a social benefactor and a hero.

nature-intrinsic-value.rationale: Said preserving the planet is common sense for the enjoyment of human beings and criticised fanatical environmentalism.

limit-population.rationale: Described population control and abortion as Malthusian ideas and said human beings are not a cancer to be eliminated (Davos 2025).

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Said the Industrial Revolution multiplied world per-capita GDP by about twenty and lifted 90% of humanity out of poverty.

accelerate-technology.rationale: Told Davos in 2026 that AI is a booster of increasing returns and that politicians should stop bothering those building a better world.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Says capitalism beat the Malthusian trap and that productivity can multiply by a thousand.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Endorsed Benegas Lynch's definition of libertarianism that lists the division of labour and social cooperation among its fundamental institutions.

distribute-by-need.rationale: Calls redistribution "at gunpoint" and the idea of social justice sinister and unjust.

production-for-use.rationale: Defends profit-seeking enterprise as the source of social benefit and warns against the state distributing wealth.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Said the successful entrepreneur does not take wealth from others but contributes to general wellbeing.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Calls socialism a failure that killed over 100 million people and rejects collectivism in all forms.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Said commerce guarantees peace and freedom guarantees commerce (quoting Bastiat at the UN, 2024).

taxation-theft.rationale: Argued in Davos 2024 that taxes are coercive, nobody pays them voluntarily, and that the state therefore finances itself through coercion; in 2025 spoke of wealth distributed at gunpoint.

harm-principle.rationale: Defines libertarianism by the non-aggression principle and unrestricted respect for others' life projects, but supports banning abortion and opposes public promotion of some practices.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Attacks the quota-and-diversity doctrine and builds his model on individual life, liberty and property rights.

positive-liberty.rationale: Said the shift from liberty as protection against the tyrant to "liberation" through state intervention, and from negative to positive rights, is the root of the woke state.

media-academia-power.rationale: Said the woke left has captured media, culture, universities and international organisations and shapes the global conversation.

total-state.rationale: Wants a drastic reduction of the state and its limitation to defending life, liberty and property.

national-rebirth.rationale: Declared an end to a long history of decadence and decline at his inauguration, and in 2026 used "Make Argentina Great Again".

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Calls Israel the only democratic liberal state in the Middle East, moved to relocate the embassy to Jerusalem and backs its right of defence.

school-vouchers.rationale: Campaigned on educational vouchers and launched a school voucher subsidy in 2024.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Made zero fiscal deficit the core of his programme: "we cannot borrow, issue money or choke the private sector".

economic-freedom.rationale: Argued that countries with economic freedom and property rights are far richer, and that limited government and private property are the foundation to defend.

national-self-determination.rationale: Objects at the UN that Agenda 2030 attacks the sovereignty of nation-states and defends the nation-state cooperation model.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Says libertarianism already establishes equality of the sexes and criticises laws that treat femicide differently.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Presents equality before the law as the foundation of his creed and attacks quotas by group.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: His government approved Vaca Muerta oil and gas projects under the RIGI incentive regime for large investments.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Told Davos in 2025 that there is no gender pay inequality for the same task, and that labelling men as part of the patriarchy is a way to silence debate.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Built his politics on attacking the "casta" and told Davos in 2025 that the political class is both referee and interested party.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Said in Davos 2025: the functions of the state must be limited to defending life, liberty and property.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Said the founding stone of his creed is that all men are created equal with the same inalienable rights, including life, liberty and property.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Adopted Benegas Lynch's definition of libertarianism as unrestricted respect for others' life projects based on the non-aggression principle.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: His labour reform (DNU 70/2023 and the 2026 labour law) restricts the right to strike and his government adopted an anti-picketing protocol.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: Said capitalism defeated the Malthusian trap and that overpopulation fears are the basis of a sanguinary agenda.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: Listed price controls among the state tools to be abolished and DNU 70/2023 repealed the Ley de Abastecimiento and Ley de Góndolas.

party-controls-media.rationale: Denounces censorship by authorities and calls for free speech, while closing the state news agency Télam.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Rejects supranational governance of the UN, EU and similar bodies and calls for drastic reduction of supranational organisations.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: Opposes censorship and labelling to silence dissent.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Ended Argentine neutrality in favour of alignment with the US and Israel and applied to be a NATO global partner.

abolish-rental-housing.rationale: Repealed the rent law by decree, restoring free rental contracts.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Said the West is the peak of the human species and attributed its prosperity to Greco-Roman and Judeo-Christian values.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: Opposes comprehensive sex education, saying it deforms people's heads, and promised to eliminate it.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.rationale: Presented Argentina as an example of compliance with its obligations and negotiated a new IMF programme.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Says freedom, not its restriction, underpins growth and prosperity.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: Stated that appropriating the fruits of one's creativity is a principle of natural law, not conditioned on social benefit.

land-redistribution.rationale: Calls private property the foundation of his model and repealed the land law.

ban-cartels.rationale: Argued that concentrated structures and monopolies produce growth and that breaking them up would destroy it.

no-bailouts.rationale: Condemned the bankers rescued in the subprime crisis as privileged beneficiaries of the state (Davos 2025).

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Attacked quotas for any minority and ministries of women, and dissolved the Ministry of Women.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: Said Argentina failed in part because it closed itself to trade and champions open trade.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Said diversity doctrine invented quotas that undermine excellence and called for merit.

public-money-creation.rationale: Opposes the state issuing money and monetary emission as a tool of control.

delink-world-market.rationale: Attributes Argentina's decline to closing itself off from trade and champions global integration.

world-economy-extracts-surplus.rationale: Attributes Argentina's poverty to collectivist domestic policy and closure to trade.

return-lost-territory.rationale: Told the UN in 2025 that Argentina claims sovereignty over the Malvinas, though he says he will not seek conflict with the UK.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: Told Davos in 2024 that communists, fascists and Nazis are all collectivist variants with no substantive difference.

male-disadvantage-attention.rationale: Said that nobody complains that most prisoners, crime victims and war dead are men.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: Describes the Western model of liberty as the peak of mankind and calls for all nations to adopt it.

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: Created the RIGI to attract foreign investment and rejected curbs on foreign investors.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Holds private property as the first principle of his model.

foreign-land-ownership.rationale: Repealed by decree the land law that limited foreign ownership to 15 per cent of national territory.

disparate-impact-discrimination.rationale: Told Davos in 2025 that equality before the law and the data show no unequal treatment, only different career choices.

corporate-influence.rationale: Criticised privileged corporations and state-dependent firms as beneficiaries of the "party of the state".

defeat-communism.rationale: Says the fight against socialism must continue, and in 2026 called Venezuela a narco-dictatorship, though his government trades with China.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: Said free-enterprise capitalism generated an explosion of wealth and is the only tool to end hunger and poverty.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: Calls the radical feminism agenda redundant and a means of expanding the state.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: Said free-enterprise capitalism is the only morally desirable system.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Supports non-interference by the state with what adults do privately with their partners.

intersecting-oppressions.rationale: Calls feminism, diversity, inclusion, immigration, abortion and gender ideology "heads of the same creature".

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Rejected laws that make the state finance hormones and surgeries to match self-perception and criticised self-ID.

assisted-dying.rationale: Said in April 2026 that he does not agree with euthanasia because life is a gift to be honoured.

social-market-economy.rationale: Rejects regulation of market failures and social justice, and favours free-enterprise capitalism.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Says the state must be limited to defence of life, liberty and property, and wants Argentina in the vanguard of defence of freedom.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Said at the UN in 2024 that Argentina abandons its historic neutrality.

refuse-lender-austerity.rationale: Imposed austerity on himself and secured a US$20 billion IMF programme rather than refusing lender conditions.

racial-franchise.rationale: Presents equality before the law as the cornerstone of his creed.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Argued that concentrated structures are products of increasing returns and the source of growth, not threats to liberty.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Campaigned on tougher security under "he who does it pays" and kept security spending.

rent-control.rationale: Repealed the rent law and said price controls distort markets.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: Says the private appropriation of the fruits of creating and discovering is a principle of natural law.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: Said gender ideology questions the very idea of sex, which he treats as real.

local-essentials-public.rationale: Listed AySA (water) among companies to privatise.

person-over-state.rationale: Said the new social contract is a country where the state does not direct our lives but protects our rights.

racial-group-interests.rationale: Rejects group-based quotas and identity politics.

racial-pride.rationale: At his book launch said he had no reason to feel ashamed of being a white man and rejected teaching shame for the past.

free-public-college.rationale: Called universities centres of indoctrination and backs privatisation in education.

pollution-taxes.rationale: In 2023 said a company can pollute a river all it wants and the problem is lack of property rights, not lack of taxes.

future-generations.rationale: Said preserving the planet for future generations is common sense.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: His programme of zero deficit and refusal to borrow is a fiscal rule, though a statutory limit on borrowing is not documented in the sources used.

public-service-media.rationale: Closed Télam and replaced it with a state advertising agency.

women-property-inheritance.rationale: Says libertarianism establishes equality of the sexes and equality before the law.

environment-over-liberty.rationale: Rejected radical environmentalism that treats economic development as a crime against nature.

no-compulsory-union.rationale: His labour reform restricts union financing, and he is described as opposed to unions.

women-suffrage.rationale: Says all are equal before the law and that libertarianism already establishes equality of the sexes.

gender-equality-agencies.rationale: Dissolved the Ministry of Women, Genders and Diversity and later closed its successor subsecretariat.

close-ties-china.rationale: Aligns with the US and Israel and described China as communist, though he later called it an interesting trade partner and renewed the swap.

resources-common-ownership.rationale: Argued that private appropriation of what one creates or discovers is natural law.

self-ownership.rationale: Said "my first property is my body" when defending the sale of organs.

no-business-privileges.rationale: Criticised privileged corporations and state-dependent firms in Davos 2025.

distribution-by-process.rationale: Argues that justice rests on how wealth is created and appropriated, not on equality of results.

notes: Living person: only stated positions and the record (decrees, Ley Bases, vetoes, speeches) were used; nothing was inferred from his party or label. He calls himself an anarcho-capitalist but governs as a minarchist, so the state and private-courts answers use his clearest recent statement (state limited to defending life, liberty and property). Full speech texts came from Le Grand Continent (Davos 2024 and 2025, with interleaved editorial commentary that was not used as evidence); UN and Davos 2026 passages are press quotations because official transcripts were not reachable. Several earlier-career statements (guns, drugs, sex work, organ sales, central bank, same-sex marriage) come via Wikipedia and press, not primary text, and are medium or low. No on-camera political quiz was found. His 2025 Davos speech is more culturally conservative than his earlier libertarian line (same-sex marriage, migration), where the most recent position was used.
